title: Fisc36
intro: Calculate the benefit in kind of a company car
small_footnote_source_code: The source code is available at
small_hybrid: For a hybrid car, choose the corresponding fuel type
detail_registration_date_correction: The {{correctedRegistrationDate}} is used as the first registration date because a started month counts as a full month.
detail_last_day_at_disposal_correction: The {{correctedLastDayAtDisposal}} is used as the last day at disposal because the last day must not be counted.
detail_pct: The percentage of the catalogue value is {{pct}} % for the period from {{firstDay}} to {{lastDay}}.
detail_electric_emissions: For an electric car, with an emission of 0 g/km, the minimum percentage of {{pct}} % must be applied.
detail_emissions_intro: The CO₂ emission {{defaultEmissionText}}({{emission}} g/km) is {{emissionDifference}} g/km {{moreOrLess}} than the reference emission for a {{motor}} engine/motor ({{emissionReference}} g/km).
detail_emissions: Therefore, the base percentage of {{pctBaseEmission}} % must be {{plusOrMinus}} by {{emissionDifference}} % to reach {{pctTheoreticalEmission}} %.
detail_min_max_emission: But it may not be {{moreOrLess}} than the {{minOrMax}} percentage of {{pct}} %.
detail_days_in_period: There are {{days}} calendar days in the period from {{firstDay}} to {{lastDay}}.
detail_period_result: The benefit amounts to € {{amount}} for the period from {{firstDay}} to {{lastDay}} (€ {{catalogValue}} x {{pctCatalogValue}} % x {{numerator}}/{{denominator}} x {{daysInPeriod}}/{{daysInYear}} x {{pctEmission}} %).
detail_period_result_sum: The benefit amounts to € {{totalAmount}} for the income year {{year}} (€ {{period1Amount}} + € {{period2Amount}}).
detail_min_amount: But for tax year {{year}} the benefit may not be less than € {{minAmount}} (€ {{theoreticalMinAmount}} x {{daysInUsage}}/{{daysInCalendarYear}}).
